task_name: Collect Produced Materials, Upgrade Homes, and Place Two Residential Zones

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: After finishing the road layout when floating finished items appear over the factory and store, and residential zones have ready hard hats.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Collecting finished Nails and Metal allows immediate completion of pending residential upgrades (+102 population total) and frees production slots to keep working toward the 'My Sweet Town' journal goals.
preconditions: Finished Metal on Small Factory and Nails on Building Supplies Store
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Place new Residential Zones along the main residential street away from the industrial left corner.

steps.who: floating Metal on Small Factory and floating Nails on Building Supplies Store
yellow hard hat on the leftmost unbuilt Residential Zone

steps.briefing: drag Nails onto the zone to start construction.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the upper-right residential house

steps.briefing: drag Metal onto the house to upgrade it into a multi-story apartment.

steps.who: Residential Buildings icon on the right menu

steps.briefing: place two new Residential Zones to the right of the Water Tower along the main road, confirming each with the green checkmark.
open the factory production slots and drag Metal into both slots.
open the store and drag Nails into the production queue.
